text: How to buy and sell your crypto on Binance Lite welcome to Binance Lite, where you can buy and sell crypto using fiat currencies at your fingertip. In the Lite version, the trading interface and wallets are simplified for you. How to Buy Crypto on Binance Lite to buy crypto you need to complete the identity verification. First. You can see the list of crypto available on the Binance Lite homepage. Simply tap on the crypto you want to buy and enter the amount. Or you may tap on the trading button Buy to choose the desired crypto and enter the amount to buy, then select your payment method. We offer different fiat channels for users in different countries. To buy crypto, please refer to the app to see the available fiat channels for your country. For example, if you're using GBP or eur, you can choose to pay with Cash balance or pay with card. We also offer P2P trading options for some countries. For example, if you're using VND or COP to buy, apart from the two fiat options, you can choose to pay offline via bank transfer too. How to sell crypto on Binance Lite to sell your crypto, tap on the Trading button, then tap Sell, choose the cryptocurrency you want to sell and enter the amount. Then select how you want to receive the fiat currency. You can choose to receive your payment via Fiat channels or P2P trading. Binance Lite is suitable for users that are new to crypto trading, but if you want to experience our versatile trading functionalities such as futures trading, options trading and margin trading, simply go to Profile and toggle off the button next to Binance Lite to switch to Binance Professional Trade Crypto at ease now on Binance Lite.
